items.name: Nile
items.fact: Often cited as the world’s longest river.
facts: Often cited as the world’s longest river.
Flows north through 11 countries.
Empties into the Mediterranean.

items.name: Congo
facts: Deepest river; second-largest by discharge.
Africa’s second-longest river.
Forms stretches of the Republic of the Congo–DRC border.

items.name: Niger
facts: Principal river of West Africa.
The “Boomerang” river, rising in the Guinea Highlands.

items.name: Zambezi
facts: Home of Victoria Falls.
Africa’s fourth-longest river.
Forms stretches of the Zambia–Zimbabwe border.

items.name: Orange River
facts: Longest river in South Africa.
Forms much of the Namibia–South Africa border.

items.name: Limpopo
facts: River of southern Africa.
Forms stretches of the South Africa–Botswana and South Africa–Zimbabwe borders.

items.name: Senegal River
items.fact: Principal river of Senegal and Mauritania.
facts: Principal river of Senegal and Mauritania.
Empties into the Atlantic at Saint-Louis.

items.name: Volta
facts: Principal river of Ghana.
Lake Volta behind Akosombo Dam is among the world’s largest reservoirs.

items.name: Ubangi
items.fact: Chief northern tributary of the Congo.
facts: Chief northern tributary of the Congo.
Forms much of the CAR–DRC border.

items.name: Lake Victoria
items.fact: Largest lake in Africa by area.
facts: Largest lake in Africa by area.
Source of the White Nile.

items.name: Lake Tanganyika
facts: Longest freshwater lake; second-deepest.
An African Rift lake shared by four countries.

items.name: Lake Malawi
items.fact: Also called Lake Nyasa; African Rift lake.
facts: Also called Lake Nyasa; African Rift lake.
Among the world’s deepest lakes.

items.name: Lake Chad
items.fact: Shallow African lake; size varies greatly.
facts: Shallow African lake; size varies greatly.
Shared by Chad, Cameroon, Niger, and Nigeria.

items.name: Lake Turkana
facts: Largest desert lake.
In Kenya’s Rift Valley, with a shore in Ethiopia.

items.name: Lake Kariba
items.fact: One of the world’s largest reservoirs by volume.
facts: One of the world’s largest reservoirs by volume.
On the Zambezi between Zambia and Zimbabwe.

items.name: Owen Falls / Lake Victoria Nile
items.fact: The White Nile’s outlet from Lake Victoria.
facts: The White Nile’s outlet from Lake Victoria.
At Jinja, Uganda.

items.name: Lake Tana
facts: Largest lake in Ethiopia.
Source of the Blue Nile.

items.name: Atlantic Ocean
facts: Ocean off Africa’s west coast.

items.name: Indian Ocean
facts: Ocean off Africa’s east coast.

items.name: Mediterranean Sea
facts: Sea north of Africa.

items.name: Red Sea
facts: Between northeast Africa and Arabia.

items.name: Gulf of Guinea
items.fact: Atlantic gulf of West and Central Africa.
facts: Atlantic gulf of West and Central Africa.
The Niger and Congo empty toward it.

items.name: Mozambique Channel
facts: Between Mozambique and Madagascar.

items.name: Strait of Gibraltar
facts: Between Morocco and Spain.

items.name: Bab-el-Mandeb

facts: Between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden.
